title: *Mark Dowdle* last man standing
hook: 107 yards, 717 km: USA closes the Backyard Worlds on 1,120.

slides.label: What happened
slides.c: As of 22 Oct, 08:25 CEST, Mark Dowdle is last man standing at the Backyard Ultra World Team Championship. Jon Noll gave him the assist.

slides.label: The numbers
slides.c: The USA closed on 1,120 team yards. Australia ended on 1,069, Japan 1,038, Belgium 1,024 at the last report.

slides.label: Why it matters
slides.c: Every yard is a 6.7 km loop run every hour, so 107 yards means 107 hours on the move. The race ends when one runner completes a yard alone. Totals are provisional.

caption:
NEWS: Mark Dowdle is last man standing at Backyard Worlds

As of 22 Oct, 08:25 CEST, Mark Dowdle ran 107 yards (717 km / 445 miles) for the USA at the Backyard Ultra World Team Championship. The USA closed on 1,120 team yards, with Jon Noll giving him the assist. Totals are provisional.
